title: Framework glow (data half)
author: mewgenics-mods
description: The data half of mewframework's per-unit glow. shaders/fw_unit_glow.shader is the rim shader the glow engine loads as material fw_unit_glow through the game's own ShaderManager (it reads the combat outline mask and paints glow_color in a band of glow_radius texels outside the masked units); load it next to any mod that asks for a glow: `mods: <mod>, fw-glow` / -modpaths. Since glow v3 a DATA mod can ask too, with no DLL: give a unit a status named FwGlow_<rrggbb> or FwGlow_<rrggbbaa> (StatusOnSpawnIn / StatusOnBattleStart, an ability's effects, a Temporary) and it glows that colour while it carries the status. The sample FwGlowRat (characters/enemies.gon.append, spawn-only, no vanilla entry changed) glows magenta; FwGlowTempRat glows magenta through a Temporary (turns 1) and stops when it expires; keyword_tooltips + text name the sample status. No vanilla content is changed.
